method: One new full original-coordinate model, with all nine anchors and all 36 moving-pair guarded separations. Model construction, independent protobuf reconstruction and the sole capped solver call share 60 seconds with a two-second solver shutdown reserve. Offline displacement preparation is retained separately and is not a production-budget pass. Stop at the terminal call; never retry, extend or reseed. A positive must undergo separate saved-position read-back, complete original geometry and native validation before any target-witness claim. A negative only concerns the stated constructive subset.
